cause_quote: The refactor removed `{view.snapshot.guests.helpersAvailable ? (` and its alternate JSX branch from the X Control UI, changing the generated bundle hash while leaving the manifest untouched.
user_saw: Anyone building the Docker package from affected main revisions saw package preparation halt because the X Control UI asset manifest was stale.
summary: The fix updated the X plugin’s Control UI entry and stylesheet paths to use the regenerated asset hash.
reasoning: I checked the refactor’s diff and its parent manifest, which already referenced the existing Control UI assets under `e57c147e…`.
